params.columns: k UInt64, a1 Array(UInt32), a2 Array(UInt32), s1 String, s2 String, l LowCardinality(String)
params.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number + {i} * {rows} AS k, range(k % 3) AS a1, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(x * k), range(k % 5)) AS a2, hex(sipHash64(k, {seed})) AS s1, repeat('x', k % 11) AS s2, toString(k % 31) AS l FROM numbers({rows})

description: Replacement hold-out for the branch population (mix-holdout drove a change): one Wide part (200 000 rows) of UInt64, two Array(UInt32), two String and one LowCardinality(String) columns; every substream file a fresh blob, every small file inline.
